---
title: "Top of the Page"
format: html
extensions:
  support-this:
    position: top
    description: "Thank you for considering supporting this work!"
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      ko_fi: coatless
filters: [support-this]
---

With `position: top`, the support section comes first, right after the page title, so every reader sees it before the content. The default, `position: bottom`, puts it at the end of the page instead, as on most pages of this site.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    position: top
    description: "Thank you for considering supporting this work!"
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      ko_fi: coatless
filters: [support-this]
```

## Other formats

Typst, Word, and PDF put the section at the start of the document. In RevealJS, it gets a slide of its own right after the title slide.

To put the section somewhere else on the page, see [Custom Placement](qsupport-this-position-custom.qmd).
